purpose: Compare the 22 previously frozen algorithms and two experimental algorithm families, each with and without a hosted-site move.

algorithm_variants.diversity_search: adaptive diversity archive, original development version
algorithm_variants.diversity_v2: adaptive diversity archive plus hosted rigid-site moves
algorithm_variants.path_relink: archive path relinking, original development version
algorithm_variants.relink_v2: archive path relinking plus hosted rigid-site moves

budget: Fixed per benchmark, shared by all methods; see freeze_manifest.json.
primary_measure: Expected ionic steps to first hit, summing steps to hit or steps charged to unsuccessful runs, divided by number of hits.
reference: Lowest saved energy with guard plus wall <= 0.01 eV among this campaign and the separately archived same-hash system pilot; hit threshold is reference plus benchmark e_tol.
screening: Audit every record and frozen input; independently re-evaluate reference structures and screen saved candidate-hit structures for guard and wall activity. Saved best structures cannot establish the validity of every intermediate trace configuration.
development: Original versions were tested on the six published development systems at seeds 300-302 and 303-305; revised versions were created using the first set and tested on the second. A further surface-move ablation uses seeds 310-319. These are development results, not independent test-set evidence.
system_pilot: BH and SurrBH, seeds 1000-1004, 900-second per-seed cap; all 40 saved best structures pass the project's reference checks, and all 40 hit their pilot reference window.
limitations: Systems are manually selected convenience samples, not random or representative. The hosted systems reuse development-set hosts; the CHA source CIF provenance is unknown.
The system pilot suggests that these are relatively easy problems; it does not prove that the structures are physical or globally optimal.

All Cu13, Pd7/MgO and Au4/CHA reference geometries include atoms outside their initial sampling regions. In the zeolite pilot, two of ten cluster centers also lie outside the initial region; this does not by itself establish cage escape or confinement.
Frozen hosts, periodic image effects, model transferability and NEP89 short-range holes remain possible; results are not DFT and scores from different benchmark sets are not directly comparable.
The experimental methods combine established ideas; the design and small development ablations do not establish literature novelty or statistically significant superiority.
